newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 12.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 12.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Social security spending would come under tighter scrutiny according to a new bill draft being debated in parliament.
- The parliament's special committee investigating the Tocsik affair questioned the lawyers who negotiated with Marta Tocsik on behalf of municipalities.
- Police lacks funding in its fight against organised crime.
- Afternoon daliy newspaper Esti Hirlap went bust.
